newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech says 1996 capital spending rose.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech says 1996 capital spending rose.

text.p: Ameritech Corp on Wednesday said it spent $1.9 billion last year to expand and enhance its local telephone network while making total capital expenditures of $2.5 billion.
An Ameritech spokesman said the telephone services provider the previous year spent $1.6 billion on its local telephone network while its overall capital expenditures amounted to $2.2 billion.
In its annual report, the company said the overall figures included investments in security monitoring, cable television and other networks.
Ameritech also predicted the global communications market would expand by more than 70 percent in the next five years to $1.8 trillion in revenues from $1.05 trillion.
The company's shares were down 1/8 at 63-5/8 in early afternoon trading.
